sources.title: Poondi Madha Basilica — institutional history
sources.contribution: Church foundation in 1714–1718, historic Marian statue, and minor basilica elevation on 3 August 1999, as stated by the sanctuary.

sources.title: Poondi Madha Basilica — current sanctuary information
sources.contribution: Catholic pilgrimage centre and sanctuary's own announcements; current notices should govern event and visit arrangements.

sources.title: Basilique Notre-Dame de la Paix — ecclesial history and pilgrimage
sources.contribution: Founding initiative, 1986–1989 building campaign, architect Pierre Fakhoury, Pallottine pastoral custody, and pilgrimage/visiting notices.

sources.title: John Paul II — dedication of Notre-Dame de la Paix (1990)
sources.contribution: Papal dedication on 10 September 1990 and the basilica's Marian, liturgical, and charitable context.

sources.title: Lewiston Our Lady of Fatima Shrine — sanctuary directory
sources.contribution: Lewiston sanctuary founded in 1954, Barnabite custody, glass dome and Marian statue.

sources.title: Barnabite Province — Lewiston National Shrine
sources.contribution: Official name, Barnabite stewardship, exact Lewiston address and custodian contact details.

sources.title: Our Lady of Lebanon Sanctuary — institutional history
sources.issuer: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lebanon, Harissa
sources.contribution: Harissa's position above Jounieh, 1908 inauguration, Marian statue, and Lebanese Maronite Missionaries administration.

sources.title: Our Lady of Lebanon Sanctuary — mission and administration
sources.issuer: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lebanon, Harissa
sources.contribution: Maronite patriarchal relationship, international pilgrimage and continuing Catholic pastoral mission.

sources.title: Francis: Marian Prayer at the Shrine of Our Lady of Madhu (2015)
sources.contribution: Papal 2015 visit to the Marian shrine; Tamil and Sinhalese pilgrims, conflict-related suffering and displacement of the venerated Marian statue.

sources.title: Shrine of Madhu and its pastoral significance
sources.contribution: Church reporting on Madhu's Marian pilgrimage, conflict-period vulnerability and appeals to respect the sanctuary.

sources.title: Canonical Coronation of the National Pilgrim Image at Valenzuela (2024)
sources.contribution: The National Shrine of Our Lady of Fatima at Barangay Marulas, Diocese of Malolos, hosted the canonical coronation on 25 February 2024.

sources.title: National Shrine of Our Lady of Fatima, Valenzuela — official shrine association
sources.issuer: CBCP Association of Catholic Shrines and Pilgrimages
sources.contribution: Lists named ecclesial shrines in and near Metro Manila; evidence of Catholic shrine network membership only if named row present.

sources.title: National Shrine and Parish of Our Lady of Guadalupe, Makati (2010)
sources.issuer: CBCP Association of Catholic Shrines and Pilgrimages
sources.contribution: Lists National Shrine and Parish of Our Lady of Guadalupe in Makati City, with declaration date 31 May 2010.

sources.title: Our Lady of Guadalupe National Shrine, Guadalupe Nuevo, Makati
sources.contribution: Distinct parish at 1923 Orense Street in Guadalupe Nuevo; founded 23 November 1951 and dedicated to Our Lady of Guadalupe. Not Nuestra Señora de Gracia Church, Guadalupe Viejo.

sources.title: Holy See elevates Santo Tomas Padre Pio Shrine to international shrine (2026)
sources.issuer: Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Manila — Office of Communication
sources.contribution: Dicastery for Evangelization decree dated 25 May 2026, publicly declared in September 2026; Santo Tomas, Batangas elevated from national to international shrine.

sources.title: Santo Tomas tourism — Saint Padre Pio pilgrimage sanctuary
sources.contribution: Confirms local devotional pilgrimage identity and setting in Santo Tomas; municipal naming may predate the 2026 international designation.

sources.title: National Shrine of Saint Joseph, Mandaue — parish directory
sources.contribution: National Shrine of Saint Joseph, SB Cabahug Street in Mandaue, feast celebrated 8 May and ecclesial parish ministry.

sources.title: Saint Joseph shrine's silver jubilee (2026)
sources.contribution: August 2026 twenty-fifth anniversary of the church's dedication and national shrine declaration, and its current mission of worship and pilgrimage.

sources.title: Cardinal Thomas Cooray and the Tewatta National Basilica
sources.contribution: Cardinal Cooray spearheaded the building in fulfilment of wartime vow; consecrated 6 February 1974.

sources.title: Our Lady of Lanka Basilica: archdiocesan pastoral event (2026)
sources.contribution: Confirms current worship, national Marian pilgrimage and annual pastoral gathering for the sick and their families; schedules are year-specific.

sources.title: Saint Peter in Gallicantu — history of four churches
sources.contribution: Historical sequence of Byzantine, Crusader and modern churches, excavations from 1888, modern church constructed 1920–1930.

sources.title: Saint Peter in Gallicantu — church and crypt
sources.contribution: Modern neo-Byzantine church, crypt, and imagery illustrating Peter's denial and the Passion; traditional attribution, not proof of the exact Gospel location.

sources.title: Saint Peter in Gallicantu — sanctuary visitor information
sources.contribution: Site features and published visitor information; schedules may change.

sources.title: Talawila Saint Anne shrine history in the Kalpity mission
sources.contribution: Documents 1850 pilgrimage history, first chaplain in 1843, Oblate care from 1850 and earlier local foundation traditions cautiously attributed.

sources.title: Saint Anne Talawila church identification
sources.contribution: Identifies Saint Anne shrine at Talawila, Sri Lanka, with national shrine status in the Diocese of Chilaw.

sources.title: MONTSERRAT BASILICA — scoped primary-place evidence
sources.contribution: Abbey basilica, Marian image, Benedictine liturgical offices and Escolania sung devotions; published visiting arrangements are variable.

sources.title: MONTSERRAT IMAGE — scoped primary-place evidence
sources.contribution: The Moreneta is the abbey's venerated Marian image, a late twelfth-century Romanesque wooden carving; the abbey distinguishes historical image evidence from devotional legend.

sources.title: LATIRANA DIOCESE 2025 — scoped primary-place evidence
sources.contribution: Contemporary diocesan reporting identifies the Sanctuary of Our Lady of Mount Carmel at La Tirana; July 15, 2025 Mass, first communions, pilgrims and bailes religiosos documented as dated activities, not a permanent schedule.

sources.title: TABGHA PRIMACY — scoped primary-place evidence
sources.issuer: Franciscan Custody of the Holy Land
sources.contribution: The Franciscan Primacy chapel stands by the Sea of Galilee and is separate from the Benedictine Multiplication church; the identification with John 21 is a Christian pilgrimage tradition.

sources.title: JAFFA STPETER — scoped primary-place evidence
sources.issuer: Franciscan Custody of the Holy Land
sources.contribution: Acts 9–10 Peter traditions in Jaffa; current Roman Catholic St Peter's church built in 1888–1894, with Franciscan pilgrimage hospitality distinct from apostolic-era walls.

sources.title: NAZARETH ANNUNCIATION — scoped primary-place evidence
sources.issuer: Franciscan Custody of the Holy Land
sources.contribution: Basilica of Annunciation and internally venerated grotto; new church consecrated in 1969 over earlier Byzantine and Crusader remains, without treating grotto tradition as independently proven Gospel coordinates.

sources.title: TABOR TRANSFIGURATION — scoped primary-place evidence
sources.issuer: Franciscan Custody of the Holy Land
sources.contribution: Franciscan Basilica of the Transfiguration built 1921–1924 by Antonio Barluzzi in a Byzantine-era pilgrimage setting; biblical event and traditional mountain identification distinguished.

sources.title: TABGHA MULTIPLICATION — scoped primary-place evidence
sources.issuer: Franciscan Custody of the Holy Land (context on neighbouring Benedictine sanctuary)
sources.contribution: The Benedictine Multiplication church at Tabgha contains ancient loaves-and-fishes mosaics; distinct from nearby Franciscan Primacy chapel; traditional associations, not archaeological proof of a miracle.

sources.title: EINKAREM VISITATION — scoped primary-place evidence
sources.issuer: Franciscan Custody of the Holy Land
sources.contribution: 2025 Franciscan Custody report confirms the Church of the Visitation at Ein Karem, traditional house of Zechariah and Elizabeth and multilingual Magnificat; the reported celebration is historical, not a permanent programme.

sources.title: DOMINUS FLEVIT — scoped primary-place evidence
sources.issuer: Franciscan Custody of the Holy Land
sources.contribution: Franciscan Dominus Flevit sanctuary on Mount of Olives, linked by tradition to Luke 19 and overlooking Jerusalem; reference to the commemorative site documented from late thirteenth or early fourteenth century.

sources.title: VILNIUS DIVINE MERCY — scoped primary-place evidence
sources.contribution: Original Divine Mercy image painted by Eugeniusz Kazimirowski following St Faustina's account is housed in the Vilnius Shrine of Divine Mercy; pilgrimage devotion distinguished from other reproductions.

sources.title: QUEZON LOURDES — scoped primary-place evidence
sources.contribution: Official Quezon City site history identifies the Capuchin-administered National Shrine of Our Lady of Lourdes at Sta Mesa Heights and records the 1950 cornerstone; not a source for present Mass times or universal Lourdes apparitions.
